title: Retirement keys are bound by an archive-internal release pin, not recomputation (v2.0.3 instance confirmed)
note: Source trace at 50d6dac: no build, startup or verification path recomputes retirement keys from canonical matrices. PinnedRetirementKeys::from_release checks only digest(key)==pin and shape/matrix-digest labels. The pins come from pins.env in the same history-step-pack-v2 archive as the keys, so the only external anchor is the dispatch-time v2_pack_sha256. v2.0.3 transition nodes verify peer-chosen O1V2OR02 origins only through this key path, even though they embed legacy rows. For v2.0.3, the exact 268-byte pins.env preimage (SHA-256 cd91ec5e...) contains the October-reconstructed pins, and independent Poseidon2b digests of the key files equal those pins. This rules out a shipped-versus-reconstructed key mismatch for that release. Source-level key canonicity for future packs remains an open obligation. Scoped and inconclusive; no claim or bound change.
